Metro Time Helper: Taipei MRT

Privacy Policy

Metro Time Helper does not collect personal data. This page explains what the app does on your iPhone and what it never does.

Last Updated: 2026-10-04

Our commitments

  • No account

    No account is required. You never sign up, sign in, or give us your name, email address, or phone number to use the app.

  • Data we collect

    We do not collect personal data. The app does not access your location, contacts, photos, or any identifier for tracking, and it does not send the stations or times you enter to us or anyone else.

  • Everything stays on your iPhone

    All journey calculations run on your device using timetable data built into the app. Your settings, such as stations, language, colours, launch page, and reminders, are stored only on your iPhone. Deleting the app removes them.

  • Notifications

    If you allow notifications, the app uses them only for reminders you set yourself. Every reminder is scheduled locally on your iPhone; no server is involved and no notification content leaves your device. You can turn notifications off at any time in the iOS Settings app.

  • Purchases through Apple

    The 24-hour trial and the one-time unlock are handled by Apple through the App Store using StoreKit. Payment is processed entirely by Apple, and the app never sees or stores your payment details. The app only checks with the App Store whether the trial is active or the unlock has been purchased.

  • No ads, no analytics, no tracking

    We do not use third-party advertising. We do not use third-party analytics. The app contains no tracking code and does not link data to you or share it with data brokers.

  • Timetable data

    Timetables, headways, and run times come from Taipei Metro's official public data and are included in the app itself, so looking up a journey does not require an internet connection. The only exception is the original timetable PDF: it is downloaded from Taipei Metro's website when you tap the official timetable button, as an ordinary web request, and we receive nothing about it. Metro Time Helper is independent and not affiliated with Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation.

  • Questions and your rights

    Because we hold no personal data about you, there is nothing for us to access, export, or delete. If you email us, we use your message only to reply and do not add you to any mailing list. Write to the address below with any privacy question.

  • Changes to this policy

    If the way the app handles data ever changes, we will update this page and the Last Updated date before the change takes effect, and explain the change in the app's release notes.

Contact us

Questions, a timetable that looks wrong, or an idea for the app? Write to us. Mentioning your iPhone model, iOS version, the app version (shown in Settings), and the stations involved helps us look into it faster.

Email hourstag.app@gmail.com

Metro Time Helper is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation. Timetables and travel times come from Taipei Metro's official public data.
